title: Already-granted join page shows one sentence and a native button opening the exact site, including with JavaScript off
steps: From this checkout, resolve Playwright's index.mjs under node_modules/.pnpm/playwright@*/node_modules/playwright (or an installed Playwright module). Use the running Chrome CDP endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:9222; do not restart or close the borrowed browser.

Run PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=<absolute index.mjs> TEST_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/granted-access-regression node tasks/evidence/granted-access-open-site/verify.mjs. The script starts its own ephemeral localhost HTTP stand using the real seatsRoutes and a read-only fixture for an accepted Editor seat; the site's destination is a landing probe, not a running dsh.

Read checks.json from EVIDENCE_DIR and inspect desktop-light.png and mobile-dark.png. The checks exercise each of the eight interface languages twice: desktop/light with JavaScript on, and 360px/dark with JavaScript off.
expect: The script exits 0 and prints verdict PASS with checks 16.
Every language has exactly one translated heading naming wptest0929.tracy.site, no description/note, and one GET form whose action is /wptest0929.tracy.site.
The translated Open site button stays within the viewport and reaches the exact local site path with JavaScript enabled and disabled, ignoring the hostile next URL.
All stand requests are GET, all book queries are SELECT, and no browser pageerror occurs.
fence: The already-granted state uses a single localized sentence and an encoded same-origin GET form, with no script navigation or repeated instruction. This fixture checks the real join route and native navigation; the existing site router and dsh boot are outside this case.
